dict.string: Squawk listens to what your Mac is playing so the pet can wear headphones and show the beat. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
Squawk listens for what you ask it, so you can check on your agents without reaching for the keyboard. Audio is recognised on this Mac and never recorded or sent anywhere.
Squawk turns what you say into a command for the pet. Recognition happens on this Mac.
Squawk brings an agent's terminal pane to the front when you ask it to.
